payload.notes:
SecureSH 0.1.11 — self-updater reliability.

- Fixes the auto-update loop: the swap now retries until the exe is unlocked (Nuitka onefile keeps it locked briefly after exit), then relaunches the new version.
- A failed update no longer loops on every launch; the version badge lets you retry manually.

Note: 0.1.9/0.1.10 have the old broken swap, so you must download this build MANUALLY once. From 0.1.11 on, updates install automatically and reliably.

Includes 0.1.10 (RDP 32-bit colour, first-run vault creation) and all of 0.1.9 (native RDP, WebRTC/H.264/JPEG Remote Desktop with audio, Security panel).
